case_source.classification: All24 original authored training case/seed pairs plus8 already-open evaluation cases; not a new sealed evaluation

order: Original case order; original teacher then candidate on each matched case and host seed

candidate_specification.pulse_room: abs(dx)-2; positive toward velocity and upward velocity only; same-height ballistic travel + supported stopping distance + reaction travel
candidate_specification.pulse_effort: positive analytic quadratic root for available room, capped by caller effort; withhold if below minimum or actual post-pulse vertical speed is not upward
candidate_specification.supported_drive: desired_x=clamp(position_gain*dx, +/-speed*effort); request=desired_x/(speed*effort); inside settling margin with abs(vx)>arrival_speed request -sign(vx)*near_goal_counter_request
candidate_specification.arrival_observation_rule: first qualifying sample starts the span; nonqualifying or over-gap samples reset it; this is a local estimate only
candidate_specification.feedback: issued own-root proprioception, support, cooldown, energy and ceiling ray; explicit caller goal and deadline; no evaluator inputs
candidate_specification.lifecycle: retire canceled/completed/replaced goals; reject duplicate/stale ticks and generation rollback; new lifetime resets state and retires prior lifetime
candidate_specification.owner_cancellation: caller must separately revoke the host lease

evidence.metrics: Unchanged HopTask metrics, full consumed base-tick records, complete owner journal and source/host/configuration hashes
evidence.selection: One frozen authored candidate; no tuning, checkpoint execution or training in this invocation
evidence.publication: Original failure histories and reliability criteria retained; all paired results including failures published
evidence.wall_accounting: Internal measurement plus an outer process receipt covering startup through finalization; a cap or uncertain tail prevents completion
